worldcombat.skill.curse.summary: A trade: a Ghost pays a share of its maximum health on the spot and records a draining debt on the foe; any other creature pays its Speed for Attack and Defence. It needs a foe to gaze at.
worldcombat.skill.curse.use.0: Spend a chunk of your life to mark a slow debt
worldcombat.skill.curse.use.1: Trade Speed for ferocity and a hard shell
worldcombat.skill.curse.use.2: Force the foe to cleanse it or end the fight fast
worldcombat.skill.curse.description.ghos: Every %3$s s the foe loses %1$s%% of its maximum health, and the debt lasts %2$s s; only one debt can sit on a foe, and it ends when the debt runs out or the status is cleansed - leaving your sight will not shed it.
Pay %1$s%% of your maximum health on the spot, always keeping at least 5%%; you cannot cast if your health is too low. You can gaze at a foe up to %2$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.curse.description.plai: Pay Speed: Attack and Defence each +%1$s stage, Speed -%1$s stage; you can gaze at a foe up to %2$s blocks away.
Paying the Speed takes %1$s s of preparation.
worldcombat.skill.curse.stance.blood: Blood pact: pay 50%% of your maximum health, each toll at full weight, and the debt lasts only 70%% as long, but the trade is +1 stage - a heavy stake for a fast fight.
worldcombat.skill.curse.stance.steady: Steady hex: pay only 35%%, each toll is lighter but the debt lasts 1.35x as long, and the trade stays +1 - slow attrition that grinds through.
worldcombat.skill.curse.timing: Cast on a foe. After %1$s s of preparation it spends %3$s PP, recovers %2$s s, and commits a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.curse.preference.blood: On: a Ghost pays 50% of its maximum health and each toll takes 25%, but the debt lasts only 70% as long, and the non-Ghost trade is +/-2 stages (3 from level 50). Off: pay 35%, each toll about 14%, the debt lasts 1.35x as long, and the trade is +/-1 stage (2 from level 50). The depth of the price and the patience of the debt trade off.
worldcombat.skill.curse.preference.ai.ma: Only curse a threat within this distance; lower casts up close, higher will start the debt from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.curse.preference.ai.bl: A Ghost only pays half its life while above this health ratio; lower stakes life more freely, higher only curses near full health.
worldcombat.skill.curse.preference.ai.le: On, a companion holding its station will step out to curse.
